items.prompt: Which must pass before interpreting this pipeline timing?

options.text: Only the final checksum, since equal sums guarantee FIFO and no duplicates
options.why: Different sequences can share a checksum. The stated count, ordering, occupancy and lifetime checks are separate requirements.

options.text: Only that a timer returned a number
options.why: A wrong/hung/partial workload can still produce numbers.

options.text: The stated work and lifetime contracts
options.why: These establish the intended bounded normal work.

options.text: Only that an earlier int-ring revision passed its own tests
options.why: The EventRing source and typed-event workload need their own exact correctness evidence; prior queue tests cannot substitute for it.

items.explanation: Correctness evidence must refer to the actual source/workload being measured.
